Indikator 15 tracks the proportion of patients newly diagnosed with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] who develop a severe cardiovascular complication within one year. The specific outcome measured by this indicator has shifted in the reporting over time: the 2023 report defines it as the incidence of [[iskaemisk-apopleksi|Iskæmisk apopleksi]] (ischemic stroke) [^src1], while the 2024 and 2025 reports define it as the development of heart failure (hjertesvigt) [^src2] [^src3]. The indicator is evaluated across national, regional, and local health cluster levels in [[danmark|Danmark]] to monitor the quality of post-diagnosis care and long-term patient outcomes.

Across all reporting periods and geographic levels, the standard for Indikator 15 was universally unmet. In the 2023, 2024, and 2025 datasets, every region and health cluster recorded a "Standard opfyldt" (standard fulfilled) value of 0, indicating that no administrative unit successfully met the target threshold for this indicator [^src1] [^src2] [^src3]. 

When tracking ischemic stroke (2023 report), the national rate was low and relatively stable, moving from 1.2% in 2019/20 to 1.3% in 2020/21, and dropping to 1.1% (230 out of 21,045 patients) in 2021/22 [^src1]. For heart failure (2024 and 2025 reports), the national rate showed a more pronounced improvement, declining from 9.0% in 2020/21 to 7.6% in 2021/22, and further to 6.1% (1,322 out of 21,804 patients) in 2022/23 [^src2]. The 2025 report confirms that this lower rate was sustained, with the national heart failure rate holding at 5.8% for both the 2022/23 and 2023/24 (01.07.2023 - 30.06.2024) periods [^src3].

In the 2023 report (ischemic stroke, 2021/22), [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] (1.4%) and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (1.3%) had the highest rates, while [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] had the lowest at 0.8% [^src1]. In the 2024 report (heart failure, 2022/23), the highest rates were concentrated in specific clusters: [[sundhedsklyngen-nykoebing-f|Sundhedsklyngen Nykøbing F]] (8.5%), [[sundhedsklyngen-holbaek|Sundhedsklyngen Holbæk]] (8.0%), and [[sundhedsklyngen-slagelese|Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse]] (7.5%) [^src2]. The lowest rates were seen in [[sundhedsklynge-sydvestjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sydvestjylland]] and [[aarhusklyngen|Aarhusklyngen]], both at 4.5% [^src2]. By the 2025 report (heart failure, 2023/24), [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] emerged as a significant outlier with the highest rate at 9.0%, followed by [[sundhedsklyngen-nykoebing-f|Sundhedsklyngen Nykøbing F]] (8.5%) and [[sundhedsklyngen-holbaek|Sundhedsklyngen Holbæk]] (8.3%) [^src3]. The lowest rates were recorded in [[sundhedsklynge-syd|Sundhedsklynge Syd]], [[sundhedsklynge-sydvestjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sydvestjylland]], and [[randersklyngen|Randersklyngen]], all at 4.5% [^src3].

Beyond the specific metrics of Indikator 15, the comprehensive methodology, additional clinical indicators, and broader organizational context for the Danish atrial fibrillation quality improvement initiatives are extensively detailed across the introductory, analytical, and supplementary sections of the 2023 [^src4] [^src9] [^src10] [^src21] [^src11] [^src22] [^src12] [^src36] [^src28] [^src29] [^src38] [^src7] [^src35], 2024 [^src8] [^src13] [^src42] [^src14] [^src15] [^src6] [^src44] [^src16] [^src30] [^src31] [^src26] [^src25] [^src45] [^src37] [^src32] [^src23] [^src48] [^src47], and 2025 [^src49] [^src17] [^src18] [^src19] [^src20] [^src5] [^src33] [^src40] [^src46] [^src24] [^src41] [^src39] [^src34] [^src27] [^src43] [^src50] annual reports.
